title: Shadows House
titleRomaji: Shadows House

synopsis: In the depths of a murky mansion lives a group of enigmatic nobles known as...the Shadow family. With no visible features to speak of, these mysterious aristocrats employ living dolls to act as their “faces.” Kate and Emilico are one such pair of mistress and servant, dwelling in their own little world and learning from each other bit by bit with every new day. But in a house of locked doors, living according to rules from no apparent source—how long can their blissfully peaceful existence truly last...? (Source: Yen Press)

One day, when he learns of the brutal death of a young man to which he sold his first sword, he realize his own inexperience and decides to adopt a new attitude by following an exacting training. title: Death's Daughter and the Ebony Blade
titleRomaji: Shinigami ni Sodaterareta Shoujo wa Shikkoku no Ken wo Mune ni Idaku
titleEnglish: Death's Daughter and the Ebony Blade
titleNative: 死神に育てられた少女は漆黒の剣を胸に抱く
synonyms: The Little Girl Raised by Death Holds the Sword of Death Tightly
synopsis: Once upon a time, in a forgotten temple in the middle of a deep, dark forest, a god of death stumbles across a baby girl called Olivia and takes her in to raise as its own. Under the death god's tutelage, little Olivia spends her days studying to become a brilliant tactician and master of the blade. But her destiny changes irreversibly upon her fifteenth birthday. When the death god suddenly vanishes, Olivia must leave the forest and make for the battlefield! But none of her books or drills have prepared her for other people—nor for the fearsome war between a mighty empire hellbent on uniting the continent and a kingdom struggling to maintain its autonomy as the last remaining holdout against the imperial conquest. What Olivia lacks in social skills she makes up for with martial prowess, and when she arrives on the scene, no one on either side will know what hit them. As she searches for her missing teacher and fends off the empire, the epic tale of Olivia and her ebony blade begins! (Source: J-Novel Club)

The Yandere Sister Just Wants Me to Bully Her
synopsis: Gu Xing, a novelist, deeply detests manipulative women who play coy, so she intentionally created such a main character for her webnovel, so she can abuse the fictional character in all sorts of ways! However, she never imagined that she would end up transported into her own story, and now she gets to take it out on her personally! But due to her own fetish for pretty girls, she couldn't bring herself to harm the beautiful protagonist she created, and she eventually ends up becoming her protector instead… As she was worrying about her own mixed feelings, the supposedly helpless protagonist pushes the male lead away and insistently confesses her love for Gu Xing instead! What! So I was the one being protected all along! (Source: Bilibili, translated)
